vwap.label: EXPLAINED

caption.title: VWAP: the one line day traders watch
caption.text:
VWAP is the volume-weighted average price for the day: each bar's typical price (high + low + close) ÷ 3, weighted by volume. Real example: SPY on Sep 24, 2026 had a VWAP of 766.54 at the close and closed at 767.18, above it.

Data: Webull SPY 5-min bars. Educational only, not financial advice.
#VWAP #daytrading #trading #stockmarket #SPY

sources: VWAP: standard volume-weighted average price formula

scenes.vo: There's one line almost every day trader watches. It's called VWAP.

scenes.title: VWAP in 3 steps
scenes.vo: Take each bar's typical price: high, plus low, plus close, divided by three. Multiply it by that bar's volume. Then divide the running total by the running volume.

scenes.title: Above or below?
rows: Higher than today's volume-weighted average price
Lower than today's volume-weighted average price
scenes.vo: If price is above VWAP, it's higher than the average price paid today, weighted by volume. Below it, it's lower.
